title: Microbes and dietary fiber
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Microbes in the large intestine can ferment some undigested dietary fibers, producing metabolites including short-chain fatty acids. Different fibers are fermented to different extents.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Where can gut microbes ferment some dietary fibers that escaped digestion in the small intestine? Microbes in the large intestine can ferment some undigested dietary fibers, producing metabolites including short-chain fatty acids. Different fibers are fermented to different extents.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
